geometry_authority: schema-r4; never derive gameplay permissions from art
seed_contract: SHA256(seed_hex + "|" + art_version + "|" + role), feed a documented fixed PRNG; stable y,x candidate order; do not turn 64 hex digits into JSON uint64.

surface.colour_source: C-21 warm palette: C-43 attachment-210 (primary) and C-12 attachment-57 (image 1); values are albedos solved for the dynamic farm's sun and ambient

prop_palette.scope: vertex colours of the 13 existing models only: source sRGB -> albedo sRGB; geometry, pivots, collision, layouts and the shared material unchanged
prop_palette.pick: weighted variant per placed instance from SHA256(asset|x_cm|z_cm); placement streams untouched

outer_groves.scope: extension scenery appearance: tree groves, shrub thickets, rock piles and flower clumps; no harvesting, permissions or saves
outer_groves.walk_budget: solid reservations never exceed the reserved cells of the reference art version's layout on the same parcel; grove and pile members may share their own group's cells
outer_groves.fitted_walk: Q-19 on the model-fitted profiles (0.2 m walker lattice): a previously walkable cell may only close under a new blocking prop's own profile, no open ground is sealed off, and no more cells close than under the reference layout

placement.scope: extension scenery only; non-solid core appearances have their own recipe
placement.missing_decoration_permission: reject missing or invalid schema4 walk_reserve; never guess a narrower band
placement.clearance_measure: transformed full vertex bounds/radial extent plus clearance; never use average AABB radius as containment proof
placement.collision_measure: Use the inventory primitive at the model transform. Full visual boxes and body clearance reserve placement only, never walking.
placement.validity: Full transformed visual footprint and solid occupancy stay in extension minus protected; post-placement flood fill with actual avatar clearance retains spawn, entry, all core and all protected cells reachable; reject offending prop, never repair by editing zone masks
placement.foreground: prefer low cover; tall props require screen-space player/core/HUD occlusion review
placement.rotation: seeded yaw variation; cluster axes oblique, never rotate authoritative core independently

tree.placement: outer permitted edge, broadleaf primary, sparse pine accents; groups of 2-3 only if bounds fit
tree.source_pivot: identity GLB node; minimum Y=0; place local origin at ground height, keep XZ offset, no recenter

shrub.placement: between tree clusters, not a continuous blocking hedge
shrub.source_pivot: identity GLB node; minimum Y=0; place local origin at ground height, keep XZ offset, no recenter

rock.placement: one main rock with at most two lower companions in permitted pockets
rock.source_pivot: identity GLB node; minimum Y=0; place local origin at ground height, keep XZ offset, no recenter

flower.placement: small clusters beside tree/rock groups; leave core and reserved corridors clear
flower.source_pivot: identity GLB node; minimum Y=0; place local origin at ground height, keep XZ offset, no recenter

groundcover.placement: sparse cluster foot cover; no full-field random noise
groundcover.source_pivot: identity GLB node; minimum Y=0; place local origin at ground height, keep XZ offset, no recenter

budget.caps_status: conservative first-scene art caps, not measured mobile performance limits
budget.large_parcel_policy: keep caps, preserve core geometry and scale; increase open grass, never shrink player/grid to fit

water_and_cliff.no_water_or_height_semantics: dry-ground first sample; optional outer scenery needs its own explicit geometry; no internal water/canyon
water_and_cliff.placement_region: outside core union extension, beyond boundaries.outer; optional non-navigable scenery only

schema_mapping.decoration_allowed: decoded extension minus decoded protected; full footprint check required

coordinates.boundary_rings: Use explicit outer and holes; do not fill bounding rectangle.
coordinates.shared_scene_transform: Apply identical translation/rotation to ground, mask lookup, occupancy, props and avatar.

shadows.mobile: Keep existing scene sun/shadow quality; trees/shrubs/rocks cast, small flowers/grass do not.
shadows.compatibility: Retain existing GLES sun-shadow disable. GroundShade may consume tree caster flags; do NOT disable mesh cast_shadow on trees before GroundShade scans.
shadows.ground_shade_scope: Existing MIN_H=2m means only tall pieces enter its mask; preserve it, no extra full-field shrub shadow pass.
shadows.ground_shade_integration: After final placement, use actual dynamic ground rect/chunks and a ground material supporting shade uniforms; old pond NEAR rect/masks are invalid. Bound mask allocation for maximum extent; record bytes and first-frame cost. If unsupported, report missing shadow integration rather than mark visual acceptance passed.
shadows.rebuild: Once after assembled placements; rebuild only when art version/layout changes, never every frame.
